text:
Priya: CinderBank needs a short acceptance sheet so procurement can greenlight the POC. They want throughput+latency acceptance and a one-line cost delta for reserved vs burst.
Ethan: baseline ask from them: p95 <220ms, p99 <520ms at 180 QPS sustained. i'd propose we set p95 <270ms p99 <650ms as our POC target to avoid flakiness.
Marco: traffic mix i'll use: 60% short-gen (~25 tokens), 30% long-gen (~140 tokens), 10% embed. k6 script (will share) mirrors their client batching of 4.
Priya: security items: IP allowlist, proof of SOC2 link, KMS integration note (customer CMK for Private; hosted via connector), data residency statement. SecBot: SOC2 link and cert summary posted to /shared/pocs/cinderbank/.
Ethan: run config: KV/prefix cache ON, batch_size=4, prewarm 7m, pin model to rwd-instruct-1.1 (non-quantized to match their production).
Marco: proposed runbook:
- smoke: 8 QPS x 3m
- ramp: 8 -> 180 QPS over 10m
- steady: 180 QPS x 30m
- burst test: 360 QPS x 1m x 2 (check graceful degradation)
k6 command we will run:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 32m cinder_mix_v1.js
```
Priya: capture p50/p90/p95/p99, success%, tokens/sec, 5xx count, KV hit %, model_version, GPU util. include short notes on observed cold starts.
Ethan: quick internal baseline: p95 170ms p99 380ms @100 QPS on a single A100-equivalent with batch=4. dev cluster only.
OpsLead: ballpark pricing for proposal: reserved pool sized for 180 QPS =~ $16.5k/mo; adding burst cushion to 360 QPS amortized =~ +$3k/mo. final depends on avg token lengths.
Priya: proposed acceptance criteria to give to CinderBank:
- sustain 180 QPS for 30 minutes with success rate >= 99.5%
- p95 < 270ms, p99 < 650ms
- no unexpected 5xx during steady window; documented planned failovers ok
Marco: i'll upload k6 scripts and payloads to the POC bucket and post the link.
Priya: Sec: please confirm we can include the KMS wording and 90-day audit retention in the acceptance sheet.
SecBot: Confirmed: KMS connector available for Hosted; Private supports CMK. Audit log retention 90 days (extendable). Posted exact copyable wording in /shared/pocs/cinderbank/sec_text.txt.
Priya: i'll send the acceptance sheet + IP CIDR request to the contact now. once they ack, we'll lock a 2hr window next Tue/Thu and tag ops for the run. thanks! :thumbsup:
